text:
maya: heads-up — nightly perf dashboard alerted for release-candidate v2.3-rc4. p99 latency up ~45% on long-seq workload (seq_len>1024). graph: https://dashboards/release/nightly/rc4
jack: oncall? I can grab traces and do a quick bisect if needed
li: quick probe -> KV cache miss rate jumped 2% -> 28% on several pods. eviction_count spiked. suspect KV retention change or memory pressure from new kernel paths
arjun: I grabbed a flamegraph from a repro pod — heavy time in `kernel_selector::score_kernel` and `fallback_executor`. CPU sys time increased, context switches ++
ben: also noticed batching latency drift. rollout config bumped `batcher.wait_ms` 8 -> 12 in commit abcdef (merged yesterday) — that could expose more simultaneous tails
maya: PR note: dynamic-kernel-selection PR #3456 merged yesterday. it touched kernel fallback and selection heuristics. could be related
li: paste KV profiler snippet from pod-7 (condensed):
```
kv_cache: hits=7.2k misses=2600 miss_rate=26.5% evictions=1.1k retain_bytes=4.7GiB
memstats: rss=11.2GiB heap_alloc=5.6GiB gc_pause_ms=120
kernel-selector: evals=21345 avg_score_ms=1.8 topfunc=score_kernel
```
arjun: running `perf top` shows `score_kernel` -> 34% CPU in hot path. looks like extra scoring per candidate added in PR #3456
jack: recommendation: bisect back to before #3456 and also try reverting the batcher.wait_ms change. one of those likely culprit. can someone trigger a revert patch in CI perf?
ci-bot: triggered: ci/perf/nightly#1825 with patch revert-3456. queued on pool: perf-large-gpu. link: https://ci/jobs/1825
sre: also temporarily set rollout weight for rc4 -> 0 in release manager to prevent canary traffic, tagging @product and @infra for visibility
ben: I can add a short-term metric: per-request KV hit ratio and kernel-eval-count so we can correlate in dashboard
maya: @arjun please run a local canary with revert-3456 image on two pods and attach perf traces if you see improvement
arjun: doing that now. local canary up (two pods) — initial smoke shows p99 down ~30% vs rc4 baseline. perf trace attached (paste excerpt):
```
--- perf sample ---
score_kernel 32.9%
fallback_executor 14.2%
kv_lookup 8.3%
batcher_wait 6.7%
```
jack: good sign. wait for CI run to confirm across more load shapes
ci-bot: update: ci/perf/nightly#1825 finished -> p99 restored to baseline, KV miss rate back to ~3%. artifacts: https://ci/artifacts/1825
maya: ok this blocks rc4 rollout. please open a revert PR for #3456 and revert the batcher.wait_ms change until we have a follow-up that adds unit perf tests
sre: I created a temporary release hold and notified release leads
arjun: opened revert PR #3462 (revert: dynamic-kernel-selection). tagging @eng-runtime @qa for extra perf checks
ben: opened tracking issue ENGRT-987: add kernel-selector perf tests in CI + KV stress harness. assigning to li
li: will take ENGRT-987. also will add guardrail alert if KV miss_rate > 10% for >5min during rollouts
maya: thanks everyone. follow-ups: (1) revert PR #3462 merged -> re-run canaries and release; (2) ENGRT-987 to add perf CI; (3) postmortem once we have root cause. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: note: release/rc4 rollout paused by sre at 2026-03-18T01:12:30Z
maya: filing short postmortem doc and will link after we merge revert. great triage team work :tada:
jack: nice fast bisect, nice catch on KV signal
